We study seed dispersal by the Gallotia endemic lizards to analyze the consequences of this specialized dispersal system on the genetic structure of the plant.” (Via <a href="http://web.me.com/pedroj/Weblog_de_Pedro/My_Blog/My_Blog.html" target="_blank">Weblog de Pedro</a>.)</p>
